posts.subject: Will Lenovo LOQ 15APH8 Output 1440p 240Hz via HDMI 2.1 or USB-C to DP on Legion 27Q-10?
posts.author: Spidey-100
posts.message_html:
Hi,
I’m using a Lenovo LOQ 15APH8 laptop(ryzen 7 7840 hs & rtx 4060 varient) and I’m planning to buy the Lenovo Legion 27Q-10 monitor (2K, 240 Hz).

I have a couple of questions before purchasing:

If I connect the monitor using HDMI 2.1 (laptop) to HDMI 2.1 (monitor), will I be able to achieve the full 240 Hz refresh rate at 1440p?
If I use a USB-C to DisplayPort cable, will the monitor be driven by the dedicated GPU (dGPU) or the integrated GPU (iGPU)?
Regardless of whether NVIDIA Optimus is enabled or disabled, are the HDMI and USB-C (DisplayPort Alt Mode) ports on the Lenovo LOQ 15APH8 physically wired to the dGPU or the iGPU?

posts.subject: Re:Will Lenovo LOQ 15APH8 Output 1440p 240Hz via HDMI 2.1 or USB-C to DP on Legion 27Q-10?
posts.author: Hector_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi Spidey-100!

Thank you for reaching out to the Lenovo Community with your inquiry regarding the Lenovo LOQ 15APH8 laptop and the Legion 27Q-10 monitor. I appreciate your detailed questions, and I’m here to assist.

It is not guaranteed to achieve this refresh rate when lowering down the resolution, but as per monitor support the PSREF specs mentioned the following:

Supports up to 3 independent displays (native display and 2 external monitors via HDMI®, USB-C®) • HDMI® supports up to 4096x2160@60Hz • USB-C® supports up to 5120x3200@60Hz

If you have additional questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask.

Best regards,
Hector_Lenovo
